$description: Apollo theme registry (ADR-0011). One baseline library, four themes as override sets at the semantic tier. Mono = base; Legacy = populated override; Console + Supercharge = declared nullable slots (ADR-0010). This file is the single source of truth for which colour belongs to which theme, consumed by _validate_theme_provenance.py.

apollo-legacy.label: Apollo Legacy
apollo-legacy.role: Retained for legacy interfaces; superseded over time, never deleted.

ownsHexes.#DB0011: Legacy brand red — primary CTA, tabs/active, progress/complete, rag/error (dark)

apollo-mono.label: Apollo Mono
apollo-mono.role: ★ The baseline built now — 'very mono': monochrome throughout, colour ONLY in RAG status + dataviz.

ownsHexes.#B92F1E: Mono's only red — RAG breach + dataviz loss ONLY (R-D19, R-D7/R-D14). Never action/nav.

apollo-console.label: Apollo Console
apollo-console.role: Branded HSBC library (was Apollo UI). Broader new-colour palette.

notes.resolution: resolve(role, mode, theme): theme override wins; else base (Mono). Components stay theme-blind.
notes.gate: A Mono-designated surface (see _STYLE-PROVENANCE.md) must not resolve to, or hardcode, another theme's ownsHexes.
notes.backlog: tabs/active and progress/complete need a Mono value ruled (R-D19) before their Legacy red can be gate-seeded as blocking.
